_comment: BAND-SPLIT. Band-local trainers for band3_the_river_lock. `order` is this entry's index in the merged array and is the ONLY thing that decides merge position -- never file order, never band order. Existing entries keep the index they had before the split because the merged array order is the order trainers are placed. A new entry in this band takes an unused order in this band's reserved range 3000-3999, which no other band can collide with; do not renumber an existing one.

trainers.name: Hess
trainers._comment: SE25. Spec sec3 Band 3 / sec12: 'two or three Team Tether trainers and a relay captain' at the relay station. The OUTER picket -- the first Team Tether personnel the player is ever stopped by, met on the approach road well before the site itself. Levels are Band 3 (~8-12) and ALL TUNABLE; never player-scaled (spec sec11/D30: a level is a real level, and the world does not move to meet you).
trainers._site: SE23 IS NOT BUILT YET. These four stand at the relay SITE, whose one authored coordinate is data/config/relay_site.json's `site.centre` [108, 34] -- on the quarry's own conduit bearing toward the stronghold (old_quarry.json's [229.8,-144.4]), 150m out from the quarry floor. Every position below is derived from that centre. When SE23 builds the station it should ADOPT relay_site.json's centre rather than pick another, and move these four with it if it needs to.
trainers._comment_ow5d: OW5D, docs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2: moved by the same uniform (+242,+3726) offset as relay_site.json's `site.centre` (108,34)->(350,3760).
trainers._comment_gate_d3: GATE-D3. OW5D's own placement, along the site's internal conduit bearing, left Hess only ~22m short of the site centre -- alongside Orrin, Dell and Vance in an 18m span, which is exactly what prompt 64 names as the failure: 'The route should not jump from wilderness directly into the four-person relay gauntlet.' Moved OUT onto the spine road itself (terrain_playground.json trail.bands[2], the (230,3670)->(350,3760) leg the player actually walks into the region), 140m short of the site centre. `facing_deg` recomputed for the new leg: the trainer faces back down the direction the player arrives from, opposite the (0.8,0.6) travel bearing of this leg, atan2(-0.8,-0.6) = -126.9 deg (not the old -34.4, which described the site's own separate conduit-approach frame Orrin/Dell/Vance still stand on). Ground measured with a scratch heightfield probe (tools/_probe_band3.gd, not committed): -3.20m, 1.04m of spread over an 8m box -- flatter than the old site, comfortably inside an 11m arena.
trainers._comment_gate_d3_round4: GATE-D3 round 4. Moved 7m back down the road to stand AT the checkpoint gap instead of in open ground several metres behind it. The blind critic's reading of the previous placement was exact -- 'the single figure stands on the open road several metres behind the props... nobody is stationed at the gap' -- and a barricade with nobody in the gap is scenery, not a checkpoint. Kept 1.2m off the road centreline on the leg's own normal so the gap stays walkable: props.json's own `_why_rebuilt` records why nothing in this band stands on the walking line any more, and putting the picket there instead of a crate would have been the same defect wearing a person.
trainers._why_here: On the spine itself, ~135m short of the site centre, right past the bend where the road turns into the relay approach -- the first Team Tether contact of the region, past the new camp clearing (vegetation.json order 3000) and the checkpoint prop cluster (props.json `relay_approach_checkpoint`), well before any sign of the compound.
trainers._comment_base_0830: T3-INSTALL, 2026-08-30. Assigns this individual a distinct generated body (docs/ASSET_LEDGER.md's T1-NPC-CAST entries) instead of the rank's shared 'grunt' silhouette -- see npc_ranks.gd::config_for()'s base_override. trainers.name: Orrin
trainers._comment: SE25. The INNER picket -- the second stop on the same road, a little stronger and a little further in. Two grunts before an officer before the captain is the rank ladder NP2's palettes exist to make readable at gameplay distance.
trainers._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation, same (+242,+3726) offset as relay_site.json's `site.centre`.
trainers._comment_gate_d3: GATE-D3. Moved out with Hess (see that entry's own `_comment_gate_d3`) onto the same spine leg, roughly midway between Hess and the site centre rather than 13m from it -- so the picket line is a real gradient the player walks through (Hess -> Orrin -> Dell -> Vance, each a step deeper and a step stronger) instead of a cluster met all at once. `facing_deg` recomputed the same way Hess's was: -126.9, facing back down the leg toward the incoming player. Ground: 4.24m, 2.57m spread over an 8m box (tools/_probe_band3b.gd, not committed) -- rougher than Hess's spot but inside the same tolerance the old site positions already shipped at (Dell's own original spread was 2.31m).
trainers._why_here: On the spine, roughly 70m short of the site centre and 60m past Hess -- the second checkpoint, close enough to the compound that Team Tether's presence now reads as continuous rather than as two isolated encounters.

trainers.name: Captain Vance
trainers._comment: SE25. The relay captain, and the fight SE27 is waiting on. `rank: captain` puts him a full step above Dell's bronze and a full step below the Warden's crimson on NP2's badge ladder -- spec sec36's rank read, made at a glance rather than in a title card. Three creatures, the highest levels in the chapter so far (11-12, TUNABLE), and the only reward in the table carrying an xp_bonus: this is the end of a four-battle site, not a roadside challenge.
trainers._authority_not_menace: See data/dialogue/trainers.json for the lines. He is the most articulate of the four; Tether personnel believe the barriers are necessary work and that the player is interfering with it.
trainers._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation, same (+242,+3726) offset as relay_site.json's `site.centre`.
trainers._comment_ow6: OW6 (owner: 'the captain to challenge is way too close to where you start'). Verified rather than moved: this site's own position is a fixed 3.6m offset past `relay_site.json`'s console (see `_why_here` below) and gates SE27's rescue conversation, so it is not free to relocate without moving the whole relay station. Distance was the open question, and it is now answerable for the first time with real data -- OW5-walk's measured spine (11,316.6m walked, 37.7min, walked/config ratio 0.983) puts this site's own waypoint (wp42, (350,3760)) at 5969m of authored polyline / 51.8% in, ~19.5 walked minutes, behind three prior fights (Hess, Orrin, Dell) at the same site. Not 'right next to the village' by any measure -- OW6's premise (the captain_field stand-in that WAS at (52,-122), effectively at the village, per OW5D's own note on that entry) does not describe this trainer. Left in place.
trainers._why_here: At the console end of the site, 3.6m past centre on the bearing, so he is between the player and the captive -- the fight cannot be walked around. Ground -2.31m, 1.05m spread.
trainers._comment_defeat_flag: SE27 waits on exactly this id. data/config/relay_site.json gates the captive's rescue conversation on it, and nothing else in the chapter sets it.

trainers.name: Captain Oreth
trainers._comment: SF34. The third captain: Water-led but deliberately BALANCED (spec §3 says 'Water/balanced'), so a party built to answer the first two cannot walk this one on type alone -- two Water and one Ground, the only mixed team of the three. Top of the band's tunable 10-16.
trainers._comment_palette: A regional accent laid over the CAPTAIN rank -- the terracotta of the river lock's warm stone, sitting between the other two. All three sit in the CAPTAIN RANK's own warm oxblood family (npc_ranks.json, `#d4a3a3`) at roughly its luminance, rather than in the olive/tan/slate they used to carry. That is the actual fix VIS-CAST landed here: NP2-grunt-wire moved the captain rank to the reserved faction colour, these three overrode `palette` wholesale, and `trainer_npc.gd::model_config()` REPLACED the whole dictionary instead of merging it -- so the oxblood reached the generic `relay_captain` and reached none of the three captains a player actually fights. `model_config()` now merges `palette` per surface, and these hexes are inside the family the merge is there to preserve. HONEST LIMIT, measured rather than assumed: every human rig carries one fused material addressed by a single `"*"` key, so the body palette is the only dial there is, and it is now spent on faction identity. Three accents held inside one reserved colour at one luminance moved the RENDERED torso by only a few points per channel in the cast capture -- these read as one faction with a nuance, not as three visibly different coats, and no hex inside this family will do better. Real per-site separation needs a dial that is not the faction colour: a second material on the rig, an accessory, or a per-site prop. The site's own character otherwise lives in `_why_here` and the dialogue, which is where it does the real work anyway.
trainers._comment_ow6: OW6. Measured against OW5-walk's real spine (see relay_captain's own `_comment_ow6` for the method): nearest spine point is 6830m of authored polyline / 59.3% in, ~22.4 walked minutes -- second of the four field/relay captains. Left in place.
trainers._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation to (-100,4350), section 3.1's own text: 'Riverwatch Captain sits off-spine on the Band 3/4 seam.' `facing_deg` UNCHANGED and stale -- see captain_field's own OW5D note. This captain's whole `_why_here` below describes a posting that watches for a river that, per this same macro-layout document (section 5), now actually exists nearby (the river crosses the corridor at z~4200, per section 10.2's Old Mill Crossing row) -- the 'no actual watercourse here yet' caveat is arguably resolved by the new geography, but confirming that is OW5C's river work, not this pass's.
trainers._why_here: The low draw at the foot of the Rise's south-east flank -- the lowest ground in the upper Meadows (h=-6.54m, 6.9m below the Field Captain's pasture), which is where the ridge's runoff would collect and what a Riverwatch posting is watching. MEASURED: 1.48m spread, worst slope 10.5 degrees over an 8m pad, 209m out. HONEST LIMIT, recorded rather than papered over: there is no actual watercourse here yet -- the Meadows' only running water is the west stream and the pond (terrain_playground.json `water`), and Band 3's river geography is SE22's, not this item's. This is the right SHAPE of ground for the posting and the terrain lease is held elsewhere, so no bake was run to put water in it. If SE22 ever cuts an upper draw, it belongs on this spot. STALE after OW5D's move -- see `_comment_ow5d` above.
trainers._why_t3_reward: T3-REWARD, owner-direction §14 ('Captain 3: Sigil + final preparation unlock/reward'). Riverwatch is the third of the three regional captains (see this entry's own `_comment`), and the last Sigil collected physically opens the Meadows Hall approach (Sec3's own 'the three physical Sigils open the old Hall/stronghold approach') -- so its own payout is the last thing the reward ladder can hand over before that gate. elixir_vigour (permanent max HP, capped by progression.json's elixirs.cap_per_stat) is the one of the three elixirs that reads as 'get ready for what is next' rather than 'get better at what you just did', which is what a final-preparation reward is for. Same unplaced-orphan gap tm_earth_fist and elixir_guard close on the other two captains: items.json's own header names elixirs as belonging 'in the world -- a dungeon, a captain, a stronghold' and none had ever actually been placed.
trainers._why_vis_cast_palette: VIS-CAST, 2026-08-23. Deliberate edit to a pinned fixture entry, made live and mirrored in the same commit per tests/test_band_content.gd's own policy. The entry keeps its index and no identity key moves -- only `palette` and its comment. Rationale in `_comment_palette` above: the faction's reserved oxblood was reaching the generic `relay_captain` and none of the three captains a player actually fights. Old values: captain_field #a89a6b, captain_ridge #a3a79c, captain_riverwatch #8f9a86.

_comment_river_nest_doss: CI-TRAINER-CENSUS, 2026-08-30. `river_nest_doss` (order 3000) briefly lived here as Band 3's 'River Nest' Local Request -- spec sec6's 'aggressive Water/Air creatures block a fishing location', with Doss's own paddlenewt/galecrest team standing for the pair. It was removed the same day it was added: it was the third brand-new distinct trainer opponent T3-ACTIVITIES tried to add in one pass, and `tests/test_chapter_content_map.gd::test_the_chapter_fields_the_number_of_trainers_it_is_aiming_for` caps the chapter at 24 distinct opponents with no headroom left (see that test's own header on why the ceiling is the wrong lever to move). Doss still exists -- same site, same character, same reward -- as a gather-and-give NPC built by `scripts/world/river_nest_clear.gd` instead of a trainers.json row; see that file's header for the full reasoning.
